Abstract
               
                  Summary
                  FlexiDot is a cross-platform dotplot suite generating high quality self, pairwise and all-against-all visualizations. To improve dotplot suitability for comparison of consensus and error-prone sequences, FlexiDot harbors routines for strict and relaxed handling of ambiguities and substitutions. Our shading modules facilitate dotplot interpretation and motif identification by adding information on sequence annotations and sequence similarities. Combined with collage-like outputs, FlexiDot supports simultaneous visual screening of large sequence sets, enabling dotplot use for routine analyses.
               
               
                  Availability and implementation
                  FlexiDot is implemented in Python 2.7. Software and documentation are freely available at http://github.com/molbio-dresden/flexidot.
               
               
                  Supplementary information
                  Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

Abstract

Summary
FlexiDot is a cross-platform dotplot suite that produces high-quality self, pairwise, and all-against-all visualizations. To enhance its use for comparing consensus and error-prone sequences, it includes routines for strict and relaxed treatment of ambiguities and substitutions. Its shading modules aid dotplot interpretation and motif identification by incorporating sequence annotations and sequence similarity information. Together with collage-style outputs, FlexiDot enables simultaneous visual screening of large sequence sets, making dotplots suitable for routine analyses.

Availability and implementation
FlexiDot is written in Python 2.7. The software and documentation are freely available at http://github.com/molbio-dresden/flexidot.

Supplementary information
Supplementary data are available online at Bioinformatics.
